server.title: ⚙️ Server
server.readHint: Read from the running server via GET /v1/config — each key shows where its value really came from.
server.healthVersionNote: The navbar dot uses /health which currently reports a stale number; this page shows the accurate one.
server.srcEnvTip: Seeded from a WS_* environment variable at start-up.
server.srcRuntimeTip: Changed at runtime with PATCH /v1/config — reverts when the server restarts.
server.srcLegend: Sources · default = built-in · env = from environment at start-up · runtime = edited live (reverts on restart)
server.modelsDirsHint: Folders the server scans for GGUF files — and the only places a Hub download is allowed to write to.
server.runtimeHint: PATCH /v1/config applies these values to the running server. They revert when the server restarts.
server.gatedWarn: Buffer, context, threads, GPU layers and KV cache type are read only when a model loads — changing them does not affect models that are already loaded.
server.appliedGated: Server config updated — the buffer/context/thread values take effect on the next model load
server.restartHint: The server refuses to change these at runtime (HTTP 409) and answers with an environment snippet — apply it before the next start.
server.requestSnippet: Ask the server for the snippet
server.applyHint: Prefer the runtime form above where possible. For any other key, edit the values below to generate a full start command to run next time.
server.restartNote: Run this before starting the server next time. It does not change the running server.
server.tokenHint: If the server runs with WS_API_TOKEN set, every API request must carry it. Save it here so the console keeps working.

data.exportHint: Downloads your preferences (theme, language, chat defaults, display name) as JSON.

diagnostics.title: 🩺 Diagnostics
diagnostics.debugContextHint: The privacy-safe snapshot attached to issue reports.
diagnostics.logEmpty: The log buffer is empty — the server has not logged anything since it started.
diagnostics.logHint: Real lines from the server's in-memory ring buffer (GET /v1/logs/tail, capped at 1000). The buffer starts empty each time the server starts; the full log also lives in data/server.log.

about.title: ℹ️ About
about.tagline: Run models bigger than your RAM — weights streamed from NVMe on demand.

tiering.title: ⚡ Auto-tiering
tiering.subtitle: Route requests to the right model
tiering.note: Short chats use the fast tier; long or reasoning-heavy requests use the quality tier. The pair is fully configurable — the default is the Gemma 12B/26B pair proven on this rig (EXP-022/019).
tiering.rule: Rule: prompt longer than the character threshold, or reasoning requested at high effort → quality tier. Otherwise → fast tier.
tiering.maxCharsHint: Requests above this total prompt length are routed to the quality tier.
tiering.noModels: No GGUF files found. Scan a folder, or type a path below.
tiering.extraArgsPlaceholder: Extra llama-server args (e.g. MTP draft flags)
tiering.needPair: Both tiers need a model ID and a file path.
tiering.resetDone: Tier restored to the shipped default
tiering.previewNote: Type a prompt and see which tier it would go to — the decision uses the LIVE config and loads nothing.
tiering.previewPlaceholder: Paste a prompt to see how the router would decide…
